_about: C6.4 (tech lead on #1073, Q1 option 1): conditional document lines a combination needs, with the facts their conditions read, which the configured checkpoint adds through the product routes (Documents; C3.6 add the fact a rule needs, with its answer values; placement). Data, not code (P-319). Every quote is word for word from the official page or form named in it, with its date; the lines and their conditions are Sample, Unconfirmed: expert (AGENTS rule 4). The same lines and words as acceptance/lib/setup_vv_m3.ts (R3, P-230 (3)).

lines.type: Letter of authorization for a minor
lines.conditionPlain: a child under 18 travelling alone, with another adult (signed by both parents, naming the adult responsible in Canada) or with one parent (from the other parent; with sole custody, from the parent who has it)
lines.sourceQuote: IMM 5881 E (05-2026), New Delhi visa office checklist, page 2 (downloaded 2026-10-19; a visa office instruction, may change): "Minors travelling alone or with a person other than their parents or legal guardians must have a letter of authorization signed by both parents and legal guardians; it must also include the name of the adult who will be responsible for the children in Canada. Minors travelling with only one parent or legal guardian must have a letter of authorization from the non-accompanying parent or guardian." canada.ca, Minor children travelling to Canada (page dated 2025-01-23, read 2026-11-02); official page, may change, under "If the parents are separated or divorced and one of them has sole custody of the child": "The letter of authorization may be signed by that parent only, and they should bring a copy of the custody decree." and "The letter does not need to be certified."

lines.type: Copy of the minor's birth certificate
lines.conditionPlain: a child under 18 travelling alone or with one parent
lines.sourceQuote: canada.ca, Minor children travelling to Canada (page dated 2025-01-23, read 2026-11-02); official page, may change: under "If a minor child is travelling alone": "a copy of their birth certificate"; under "If a minor child is travelling with one parent only": "a copy of the child’s birth certificate".

lines.type: Copy of the absent parent's signed passport or national ID
lines.conditionPlain: a child under 18 travelling with one parent or with another adult: a copy for each parent not travelling (both parents when with another adult), in one file
lines.sourceQuote: IMM 5881 E (05-2026), New Delhi visa office checklist, page 2 (downloaded 2026-10-19; a visa office instruction, may change): "You must provide a copy of the page of the passport or other government-issued identification document showing the name, photo and signature of each non-accompanying parent." canada.ca, Minor children travelling to Canada (page dated 2025-01-23, read 2026-11-02); official page, may change, under "If a minor child is travelling with a person other than their parents or legal guardians": "A photocopy of the parents’ or legal guardians’ signed passports or national identity cards should be attached to the letter."

lines.conditionPlain: a child under 18 in sole custody (the custody decree) or shared custody
lines.sourceQuote: IMM 5484 (05-2026), Document checklist for a temporary resident visa, page 1: "Minors travelling alone or with one parent must provide custody documents or a letter of authorization from the other non accompanying parent or a letter of authorization signed by both parents or legal guardians." (downloaded 2026-10-19). canada.ca, Minor children travelling to Canada (page dated 2025-01-23, read 2026-11-02); official page, may change: "The parent travelling with the child should carry copies of the legal custody documents."; "they should bring a copy of the custody decree."

lines.conditionPlain: a child under 18 who is adopted or under guardianship
lines.sourceQuote: canada.ca, Minor children travelling to Canada (page dated 2025-01-23, read 2026-11-02); official page, may change, under "If a minor child is travelling with a legal guardian or adoptive parents": "The child should have a copy of the guardianship papers or the adoption papers (whichever one applies)."

facts.label: Who the child travels with
facts.meaning: Who a child under 18 travels to Canada with. canada.ca, Minor children travelling to Canada (page dated 2025-01-23, read 2026-11-02); official page, may change.
facts.question: If under 18: who is this person travelling to Canada with?

facts.label: Custody of the child
facts.meaning: The custody arrangement for a child under 18. canada.ca, Minor children travelling to Canada (page dated 2025-01-23, read 2026-11-02); official page, may change.
facts.question: If under 18: what is the custody arrangement for this person?
